SETTING_DOCKED_TIP: As Blizzard has it: the quest log opens with the map, at its right. Off: the map (M) and the quest log (L) open apart.
SETTING_OWN_WINDOW_TIP: The map key (M) opens Ordaen's own map window: every zone stitched into one map, dragged with the mouse and zoomed with the wheel. Off: the game's map.
NO_LAYERS: No module puts pins on the map. Ordaen Quests adds its own.
NO_OPENMAP: OpenMap isn't loaded, or is older than version 4: no pins are drawn on the map.
